# Authority Engine

> Andrew Lam's public proof-of-work system for Operations Excellence, supply chain, warehousing, business analytics and disciplined operational experimentation.

Canonical: https://authority-engine-app.vercel.app/

## Core pages
- / — Operations Excellence, supply chain and analytics authority
- /about — Background, operating philosophy and credibility
- /portal — Interactive living knowledge graph
- /open-aqua — Live interactive freshwater aquarium operating system
- /insights — Evidence, case studies, experiments and decision frameworks
- /maxwell-excel — Real operating evidence and Singapore container-service scope
- /contact — Career, collaboration, professional and Maxwell service inquiries

## Principles
- Evidence is distinguished from demonstration.
- Synthetic experiments are labelled as synthetic.
- Prototypes are not presented as production systems.
- Operational claims should be inspectable and decision-relevant.
- Maxwell Excel evidence is real and anonymised; no unverified profit, savings or expansion claim is made.

## Current frontier
Open Aqua is a live browser-accessible product for structured aquarium decisions and memory. Its future physical sensing hypothesis remains explicitly unvalidated.
